messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: INCIDENT gen-queue partial degradation detected. Error spike on gen-queue v2. Page sent to @sara, @mike. Link: https://incidents.redwood.example/INC-2345
sara: got it, oncall here — triaging. can someone pull customer impact (requests/min failing) and a tentative ETA for next update? I'll start a statuspage draft.
mike: looking into model workers. can repro on canary. backlog rising ~3x. switching routing policy to fallback-model-1 now.
elena: for status copy we need SLO impact and list of affected regions. initial data: us-west and eu-west showing increased latencies, ap-south ok.
devon: metrics: error-rate for gen endpoint from 0.2% -> 12% starting 12:03 UTC. approx 4% of requests time out. no auth or data-plane errors observed. ETA for mitigation 25-30m if fallback holds.
sara: drafting initial status. putting minimal customer-facing language. posting here for quick review before publish.
legal: quick flag — do not mention internal routing names (fallback-model-1) in public note. use "secondary model" instead. also confirm no customer data exposure.
support_pager: recommend initial update now with 'partial degradation' label. add link to incident page and next update timestamp in 15m.
sara: draft:
```
We are currently experiencing partial degradation of the text generation service in US-West and EU-West. Some requests may return errors or higher latency. Our engineers are actively mitigating and have routed traffic to a secondary model to reduce impact. No customer data exposure detected. Next update at 12:30 UTC.
```
mike: +1 to that phrasing, legal suggestion applied. small edit: "reduced throughput" -> "increased latency and errors".
sara: updated draft and queued for publish. publishing now. :thumbsup:
statusbot: Status page update posted: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/INC-2345/update-1
sara: thanks all — continue to add observations here. will post periodic updates every 15m or on major state change.
devon: monitoring shows error rate falling to 5% after routing change, still above baseline. next ETA reassess 12:25 UTC.
